identity.title: Powered Industrial Truck Pre-Shift Inspection Log — Unit FL-2 (Toyota 8FGU25), Portland Warehouse, September 2026
identity.issuer: Cascade Specialty Chemicals, LLC (self-generated shift log)

scan.summary: This is a daily pre-shift inspection log for a single propane forklift (Toyota 8FGU25, unit FL-2) at the Portland warehouse, kept to satisfy the pre-shift examination requirement in 29 CFR 1910.178(q)(7). It records checklist items (tires, forks, mast, horn, lights, brakes, etc.) as OK or defective for each shift, with operator initials and notes.
scan.freshness_note: The log's last entry is September 17, 2026. Today is September 27, 2026 — ten days, and at least seven working days based on the pattern shown, have passed with no recorded inspection. A current log should show continuous daily entries up to the present.

gaps.title: No entries after September 17
gaps.description: The log shows continuous weekday entries from Sep 1 through Sep 17, then stops. There are no pre-shift inspection entries for the truck for the ten days since, including the week just before today's date.
gaps.fix: Resume and backfill (or explain the gap for) daily pre-shift inspections; confirm whether the truck was taken out of service or simply not logged.

gaps.title: No documented follow-up on Sep 9 horn defect
gaps.description: The Sep 9 entry marks the horn as defective ("X") with the note "Horn not working," but no subsequent entry documents repair, removal from service, or a maintenance ticket. The Sep 10 entry shows the horn back to OK with no explanation of what was done.
gaps.fix: Add a corrective-action record (repair ticket, date fixed, who verified) tying the Sep 9 defect to its resolution, and keep such records with the log going forward.

deadlines.title: Daily pre-shift inspection (recurring)
deadlines.source_line: Inspection per OSHA 29 CFR 1910.178(q)(7): examine before each shift; do not use if a defect affects safety.

facts.quote: Truck: Toyota 8FGU25, unit FL-2, propane · Month: September 2026
facts.affects: Identifies which truck this pre-shift inspection record covers for hazard/PIT compliance tracking.

version_of.title: Powered Industrial Truck Pre-Shift Inspection Log — Unit FL-2 (Toyota 8FGU25), Portland Warehouse, September 2026

expected_missing.title: Maintenance/repair work order for the horn defect
expected_missing.why: A defect noted on a pre-shift log is normally paired with a maintenance ticket or sign-off showing the truck was repaired before returning to service.
expected_missing.basis: similar companies, not a checked requirement

expected_missing.title: Operator training/certification records for J.R. and M.C.
expected_missing.why: Companies operating forklifts typically keep operator certification files alongside daily logs to show only trained operators are running the truck.
expected_missing.basis: similar companies, not a checked requirement

expected_missing.title: Continuation log for remainder of September and following months
expected_missing.why: A single month's log with a mid-month gap is usually followed by continuing monthly logs; none beyond Sep 17 are on file here.
expected_missing.basis: similar companies, not a checked requirement

scan.confidence_notes: The document is a clear, legible tabular log; the entries and the two gaps (missing entries after Sep 17, and no follow-up on the Sep 9 horn defect) are read directly from the table, not inferred. These two findings match the previously opened gaps for this company, so they are flagged with same_as_gap_id rather than treated as new. No new gap categories were found beyond those two.
